capabilities: Render fenced interactive-grid blocks as grids with custom row and column labels
Drag, resize, and reposition colored cards across one or more cells
Edit card content, color, and position via click, keyboard, or position fields
Add notes under column headings and color cards from a fixed palette
Convert legacy 1.0.0 grid blocks to the interactive-grid fence
disambiguation: Not a Markdown table editor; grids are custom fenced code blocks with free-positioned cards, not tabular data.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; a demo vault can be run from the repository via npm, and manual installation requires copying release files into the plugins folder.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to arrange items visually in a row-and-column grid layout inside a regular note.
summary: Markdown plugin that renders fenced interactive-grid blocks as labeled grids with draggable, resizable colored cards for layouts like itineraries and seating charts.
